author: JCon7213
quote: As much as I wanted to love this, the Xbox version is awful, glitchy and blurry. Hoping a patch will save it but I’m going back to Vice City. Maybe once they figure it out it will be better. I wanted over 10 years for this and it’s not working on release? Very disappointed

author: JCon7213
quote: From 1998 playing as a child to playing as an adult, I could want nothing more than a remake of this amazing game. I was skeptical but Nintendo not only did 100 but gave us something new, beautiful and familiar. I love coming home to Hyrule and not only starting a familiar adventure, but something visually stunning and comforting. Thank you Nintendo!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
